decision: Primary model suite is LR, Elastic-Net LR, RF, XGBoost, LightGBM and CatBoost.
reason: Provides interpretable linear baselines and strong tabular nonlinear comparators without architecture sprawl.

decision: Primary comparisons use Tier 1 and Tier 2 CBC.
reason: Directly tests the incremental value of routine CBC.

decision: Albumin, creatinine and glucose remain a predefined sensitivity extension only.
reason: Preserves the primary CBC-centered resource hierarchy.

decision: All imputation, encoding and scaling parameters are fit within training data only.
Hyperparameters are selected by 5-fold CV entirely within the training cohort.
reason: Temporal test cohorts remain locked external evaluations.

decision: Fixed-origin, rolling-expanding and J-to-I/J-to-L bridge experiments are predefined.
reason: Captures long-range, local and original-study temporal transport.

decision: Sigmoid calibration is primary; uncalibrated and isotonic outputs are predefined sensitivity analyses.
reason: Calibration reliability is a central deployment outcome.

decision: AUROC, AUPRC, Brier, calibration slope/intercept, ECE and operational testing-burden endpoints are locked.
reason: Discrimination alone is insufficient for clinical triage.

decision: Testing-burden endpoints are evaluated at sensitivity targets 90%, 95% and 97.5%.
reason: Allows clinically interpretable comparison of targeted confirmatory testing strategies.

decision: All key temporal iron experiments are repeated in observed and matched cohorts.
reason: Tests whether apparent model drift attenuates when eligibility/population shift is controlled.
